entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor WASM with fingerprinting enabled will make blazor.webassembly.{..}.js point to dotnet.js in error #67766
  • OutputCaching invalid cache keys can coalesce unrelated concurrent responses #67763
  • Support `IOptionsMonitor<SqlServerCacheOptions>` for runtime configuration updates #67762
  • ResponseCaching: VaryByQueryKeys vary key can collide because the '=' name/value separator is not escaped #67760
  • Harden wildcard matching with empty segments inside #67756
  • Connection downgrades to negotiateVersion=0 when hub URL contains the substring negotiateVersion #67751
  • Make GetValidationAttributes virtual instead of abstract #67747
  • [dotnet-sdk-11.0.100-preview.7.26360.111] grandnode app launch failed with MethodNotFoundException #67755

Closed

  • Exception when trying to return `Problem` or `ValidationProblem` with an extension with a key that is already set internally #66407
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection.DataProtectionProviderTests.System_UsesProvidedCertificateNotFromStore #66637

PullRequests

Created

  • Run Blazor WebAssembly in a Web Worker #67768
    community-contribution
  • Skip macOS quarantined-test job on PRs #67767
  • Support AuthorizationPolicy and IAuthorizationRequirementData metadata everywhere #67765
  • WIP: DO NOT REVIEW - Reduce SignalR client/protocol allocations on stream-ID and header hot paths #67761
  • WIP: DO NOT REVIEW — ResponseCaching: avoid one-element string[] allocation on vary-by lookup #67759
  • WIP: DO NOT REVIEW Use generated regexes for gRPC JSON parsing #67758
  • Harden wildcard matching with empty segments inside #67757
  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine IIS NewShim ShutdownTests (dotnet/runtime#126925) #67753
    test-failure, agentic-threat-detected
  • WIP: DO NOT REVIEW — Eliminate per-request string[] allocation in conventional MVC action selection #67750
  • Fix agentic workflow detection job missing pat_pool dependency (stopgap; prefer gh-aw ≥ v0.82.6 recompile) #67749
  • Update IdentityModelVersion to latest #67748
  • Fix warning when using nullable properties in ValidationMessageStore.Add field accessor #67746
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #67736
  • Avoid ArgumentException when Problem/ValidationProblem extensions conflict with defaults #67690
    community-contribution
  • Harden test-quarantine workflow guardrails (B1/B2/B3) #67764
  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine DataProtectionProviderTests.System_UsesProvidedCertificateNotFromStore #67754
    test-failure, agentic-threat-detected
  • HttpSys: fail startup when Strict hardening cannot be applied #67720

Updated

  • TEMPORARY: Overlay custom MSBuild for dotnet/msbuild#12927 investigation #66003
    area-infrastructure, * NO MERGE *
  • Add InactiveClass parameter to NavLink #66365
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) for cookie authentication (prototype) #67388
  • Improve Blazor SSR client-side form validation #67324
  • Remove DataAnnotations' ValidationContext from MEV public API #67549
  • Simplify the generated code from ValidationsGenerator #67630
    area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Warn on Blazor components with Dispose()/DisposeAsync() but no interface #67426
    community-contribution
  • Add analyzer for RazorComponentResult parameter validation #67617
    community-contribution
  • Update AddStackExchangeRedisCache such that a dependency from DI could be used to configure the RedisCacheOptions #65475
    community-contribution, feature-caching, area-middleware
  • Fix API for QuickGrid #67733
  • Use async ChangeToken.OnChange overload in KeyPerFileConfigurationProvider #67732
  • Simplify and unify TempData and SupplyParameterFromSession serialization #65483
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview7
  • Fix placeholder flash when appending to an End-anchored virtualized list #67679
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, blocking, 11.0-preview7
  • Fix authz metadata guard consistency #67742
  • Fix validation for null nullable parameters in minimal APIs #67395
    community-contribution, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Merge endpoint metadata for dynamic endpoints. #67664
  • Treat empty query strings as null for nullable value types #65816
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Fix InputBase retaining invalid parsing state and stale validation messages after Value change #67406
    area-blazor, community-contribution
